content.text: Ugly is an Australian trick-taking/avoidance game similar to Hearts. 3-4 players, 52-card deck. Players choose trumps each round. Jacks are negative. The 7â™¦ (Ugly Card) doubles Jack penalties OR doubles trick scores if no Jacks captured. The 7â™£ (Charm Card) cancels Ugly's doubling. Card passing escalates each round.

Ugly was invented in Australia in the 1980s by CARDS (Committee for the Advanced Research into Deck Statistics), a group of university students. It is loosely based on Hearts and Knaves and is played in Canberra, Perth, and elsewhere in Australia.
All cards dealt. Pass cards (escalating each round).
